name: Fell in Love with a Girl

podcast.body: This hit from the "White Blood Cells" album gained further recognition with a brilliant music video directed by Bisergondri (Michel Gondry), famously created in Stockholm using Lego pieces. The innovative visual approach significantly contributed to the song's and the album's widespread appeal. "Bisergondri les hizo un genial videoclip en Stockholm, con piezas de lego de su hit, Feline Love, Bicaguel."
